manuscript_reviews.thm:threshold: All three current threshold clauses and both equivalences are checked against the actual graphon proofs. The below-threshold competitor, strict improvement and exclusion of every constant minimizer are unconditional. Scaling and the at/above-threshold clauses retain the author-owned CriticalClassification input. The critical optimizer clause now has a literal measure-preserving relabeling, using only the named classical CDF input in addition. This review does not discharge the remaining critical numerical certificates.
manuscript_reviews.cor:bipodalmin: The current proof is checked from actual minimizers: vertex identity, bipodal stationarity, interiority and rigidity supply the balanced branch partition and equality of values. A new theorem derives the branch bounds and converts that partition into the actual measure-preserving relabeling in the statement. Only classical sampling and nonatomic CDF transport are inputs.
manuscript_reviews.prop:pen: The full current scalar proposition is checked, including r_minus<r_plus, attained values and exact optimizer lists in all three regimes. The complete author-used stable stationary branch criterion is now explicit: a unique z in (0,fold] with mu(z)=3 gamma exists exactly when mu(fold)<=3 gamma, including the fold endpoint. Its order relative to z_c is equivalent to the reverse penalty order, with equality included. These assertions and the existing scalar classification use no external result.
manuscript_reviews.prop:family: The revised proof is checked against the analytic tail, strict clipping to the compact cube, ordered-domain/permutation reduction, exact zero-pattern converse and actual intermediate parameter-range proofs. The formal proof clips to 12 directly using q_a+2<12; this gives the same global conclusion and strictness outside the compact cube. The full compact-domain positivity and exact zero set remain author-owned numerical obligations: AAA is checked, while the full ABB and exterior replays remain unfinished. The conditional status is retained.
manuscript_reviews.cor:cover: The revised finite-convex-cover deduction is checked: vertex coordinate bounds give the support cutoff throughout each cell; a convex combination distinct from the critical apex has positive weight off it; certificate concavity then gives strict positivity and excludes the actual relaxed law. The formal proof uses the positive finite weighted sum directly rather than extracting a common epsilon. Actual twelve-cell geometry/support are checked separately; the remaining full nonlinear vertex/apex replays remain explicit internal inputs.
manuscript_reviews.thm:rigidity: The current five-step argument is checked against actual infimum-over-bijections representatives, insertion/minimal row equations, uniform functional and row estimates, measurable partitions, uniform kernel approximation and convergence of both block masses to one half. The finite-dimensional coercivity is proved through the explicit determinant margin and within-block integral bounds. Strong log monotonicity and the paired Euler equations prove equality of stationary rows, and symmetry/Fubini give bipodality. Bijective transfer returns the conclusion for the original graphons. Only classical sampling is assumed.
manuscript_reviews.lem:smallparams: Both current parts are checked with their actual expressions and constants: logarithmic moments, uniform branch bounds, all multiplier products, the seven codegree and three mean-error terms, and the resulting epsilon, mean error, vertex bound, block mass and degree estimates. The actual minimizer instantiation constructs SmallErrorData from proved optimizer and spectral deductions. The stronger block bound p0>0.4987 implies the printed 0.498. Only named KP26/classical inputs remain.
manuscript_reviews.lem:rowreduction: All current row conclusions and the revised derivation are checked on the actual eigenfunction sign blocks. This includes sign/deviation averages, residual block integrals, the seven-term codegree identity and averaged bounds, nonnegative surrogate codegrees, two Lipschitz exponential transfers, and the weighted-to-unweighted Jensen vertex estimate. The inputs are the cited KP26 reduction and explicit classical sampling/spectral data, not any of the three row conclusions.
